extra_quotes: MnCoGa films were grown on GaAs (001) substrates by a molecular -beam epitaxy (MBE) system.
The crystal structure and epitaxial relationship were characterized by X-ray diffraction (XRD) θ-2θ and φ scans.
Magnetic properties were measured using a vibrating sample magnetometer , and transport measurements were performed in a physical property measurement system .
The electronic band structure s were investigated through density functional theory (DFT) with the full-potential local-orbital code (FPLO) [34,35].
The SHC was obtained from a Wannier based tight binding Hamiltonian using linear response calculations [36].
